passages.note: Pierce voted Nay on adoption of the conference committee report for HB 1296, a bill bundling the handgun-license repeal with unrelated law-enforcement-training, theft, and juvenile-jurisdiction provisions.

passages.provision_quote: under state or federal law is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana.
passages.note: This clause alone would be chair-shaped for rung 5, but it is one provision among the bill's unrelated law-enforcement-training, theft, and juvenile-jurisdiction sections (e.g. SECTION 1's cultural-diversity, human-trafficking, and de-escalation training standards), so the single Nay vote cannot be tied to this clause specifically.

rows.reasoning: The only passage naming Pierce is his Nay vote on adoption of the HB 1296 conference committee report, a bill whose operative content spans the handgun-carry-license repeal alongside unrelated law-enforcement-training-curriculum, theft, vehicle-law, and juvenile-jurisdiction sections. Per V4.1, a No vote on a multi-subject bill proves nothing, since he may have objected to any unrelated part rather than the carry-license clause.
